scenario.topic: Decide which programming language for a new internal tool
scenario.opening_question: What trade-offs are you most comfortable with when picking a programming language for our internal tool?

options.name: Python 3.10 with Django Framework
options.upside: Rapid prototyping and wide library availability
options.tradeoff: May not handle very high concurrency efficiently
options.concern: Potential scalability issues for future heavy loads
options.best_for: Fast delivery and ease of use

options.name: TypeScript with Node.js and Express
options.upside: Good balance of performance and developer tooling
options.tradeoff: Requires more setup and type discipline
options.concern: Team members less familiar with strict typing

options.name: Go 1.20 with Gin Web Framework
options.upside: High performance and easy deployment as single binaries
options.tradeoff: Less mature ecosystem and fewer libraries than Python or Node
options.concern: Longer ramp-up time for developers new to Go

options.name: Ruby 3.1 with Rails 7
options.tradeoff: Performance can be a bottleneck under load

shared_context: The tool must be ready within 3 months
The team consists of exactly 4 developers with varied experience
The budget for development is moderate and fixed
